figures.alt: Painting of Columbus standing with a Spanish flag among armed men on a shore, with Indigenous people watching from the trees and ships at anchor behind
figures.caption: Painting by Dióscoro Puebla, 1862, imagining Columbus's landing in the Americas

books.section: Topic 1.3 European exploration in the Americas
The Early Colonial Era: Spain Colonizes the New World

primary_sources: Dioscoro Puebla, painting of Columbus's landing (1862)

parts.modelAnswer: The painting shows Columbus standing at the center of the landing party, holding a Spanish flag while armed men stand around him. Indigenous people watch from the trees at the right of the scene.
parts.prompt: Identify one thing the painting shows about Columbus's landing.

scoring.criterion: Earns the point for naming one accurate detail shown in the painting, such as Columbus holding the flag, the armed men, the watching Indigenous people, or the ships at anchor.
scoring.notEarned: Naming only that Columbus landed, with no detail from the painting, does not earn the point.

parts.modelAnswer: The painting places Columbus at the center as a heroic figure carrying the flag, which shows that 19th-century viewers celebrated him as a founder of the Americas. The image honors the landing rather than questioning it, so it tells us about 1862 as much as about 1492.
parts.prompt: Explain what the painting reveals about how 19th-century viewers saw Columbus.

scoring.criterion: Earns the point for explaining what the painting shows about 19th-century views, such as Columbus celebrated as a hero or founder.
scoring.notEarned: Describing only what the painting shows, with no link to 19th-century views, does not earn the point.

parts.modelAnswer: The painting was made in 1862, nearly four centuries after the landing, by an artist who was not there. It shows what a 19th-century painter imagined, not what the shore looked like in 1492.
parts.prompt: Explain one limit of the painting as evidence about the landing in 1492.

scoring.criterion: Earns the point for explaining one accurate limit, such as the painting's late date, the artist's absence, or its imagined details.
scoring.notEarned: Stating only that the painting is old, with no limit explained, does not earn the point.

stimulus.source_note: Painting by Dioscoro Puebla, 1862, public domain (pre-1930 / CC0); the painting imagines an event from 1492 and was made nearly four centuries later.
stimulus.text: Painting by Dioscoro Puebla, 1862, imagining Columbus's landing in the Americas in 1492. In the painting, Columbus stands at the center holding a Spanish flag, with armed men around him and Indigenous people watching from the trees at the right. Ships lie at anchor in the sea behind the landing party. The painting was made nearly four centuries after the event it shows.
